title: Open-source ACIS record coverage and DXF projection ceilings
mode: Primary-source web research plus local implementation cross-check and plan update
baselineQualification: The shared worktree was already broadly dirty. Local source and plan observations refer to the shared worktree, not a clean checkout at baselineCommit.
scope: Reconcile ezdxf 1.4.5 ACIS API/entity limits and GDAL DXF reader/projection limits against the current libdxfrw ACIS projection and coordinate-test owners.
Identify only implementation-ready comparator refinements and avoid duplicating existing findings or subplans.
Preserve generated-only fixture policy, reduced per-slice validation cadence, existing support boundaries, and deferred external qualification.

method.kind: Current primary-source web review and local source/test/plan cross-check
method.limitations: Peer documentation and mutable stable/master pages establish project-documented route limits, not runtime behavior for an unpinned build. The ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layouts; no ACIS format rule was inferred from peer limitations.

sources.revision: Stable documentation identifies release 1.4.5; no package/source artifact was installed or run.
sources.observed: The ACIS API loads SAT/SAB and exposes carrier export; mesh_from_body is documented for flat polygonal faces only, while curved-surface tessellation requires a kernel. Pattern, Wire, and Subshell are documented as not implemented and Attribute as unsupported. Export can reject unsupported structures; typed parsing may reduce unsupported records to NONE_ENTITY. This is a bounded DXF/ACIS route, not complete ACIS graph or B-rep evidence.

sources.revision: Current stable driver documentation reviewed 2026-10-19; no GDAL binary run.
sources.observed: Binary-DXF reading is documented starting with GDAL 3.12. RawCodeValues is opt-in and covers codes not handled by the reader, not a full record stream. AC1027+ 3D-extensible mode exposes raw ASM data and a 12-real transform but skips solids by default and does not create OGR solid geometry. DIMENSION, LEADER, and MULTILEADER lack the documented OCS/elevation geometry projection.

sources.revision: Current shared worktree; files were read locally and not modified.
sources.observed: DRW_AcisProjectionReport includes unsupported Pattern, Wire, Subshell, p-curve, curve, and surface counts. The generated rooted graph test asserts those counts and asserts that B-rep validity is not checked. The report has no Attribute-specific counter; this pass does not establish whether such records affect the selected geometry projection, so it adds no finding and recommends no speculative grammar.

rules: Keep peer ACIS parse outcome, carrier association, graph reachability, geometry projection, B-rep validity, and native application acceptance separate.
Use ezdxf mesh output only for its documented flat-face projection; do not use it to validate curved B-rep semantics.
Use GDAL 3.12+ only for the exact Binary-DXF, raw-group, raw-ASM, transform, or documented geometry cell; DIMENSION, LEADER, and MULTILEADER geometry are not applicable to its OCS projection.
No peer runtime, dependency, fixture, CTest registration, full suite, or per-slice validation-frequency change is introduced.
